trailhead.label: Parcheggio Sant Hubertus, the board’s start

cautions: Bridges and wet rock beside the waterfalls in the Souto de Ra Stua gorge.
Cows and horses graze round Malga Ra Stua in summer: keep your distance.
The road to Ra Stua carries a shuttle bus in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
